additional_info.subject: Additional description:
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Yesterday February 8, a client attempted to start a charging session three times between 2:02:30 PM and 2:11:44 PM (CU time). In all three attempts, the authorization was successful; however, after the connector was plugged into the vehicle, the charger did not deliver any energy.
The client then repeated the same procedure on charger 170002442, and the charging session started correctly without any issues.
Could you please check the logs to investigate what may have caused the problem?
Thank you
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d

additional_info.subject: ID0477198-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002442]Check on logs CRM:02681001410
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
Following your request, we have reviewed the logs on our end regarding the failed charging session.
The analysis confirms that the session failure was caused by an
unstable internet connection
. As shown in the attached screenshot, the logs explicitly report the status
"Network unreachable"
at the time of the event. This indicates that the charger lost its connection to the server, preventing the session from continuing.
Please let us know if you require any further assistance, or if we may proceed with closing this ticket.
With best regards
,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
